text:
Emily (Partnerships): FYI — Flux Labs (LangChain partner) asked about a joint marketplace listing + SSO flow through our gateway. They want a coordinated announcement, compatibility badge, and a short integration guide. Can we sync on requirements? :calendar:
Samir (Platform Eng): Do we have any existing SSO contract templates for ISVs? Need to know if Azure/Google marketplace sign-on differs from our private gateway flow.
Grace (Integrations): We have a lightweight SSO handshake doc for connectors, but marketplace SSO usually needs OIDC metadata + redirect URI whitelist. I can share the checklist.
Olivia (Solutions): +1 on checklist. Also want to surface expected runtime footprint for a sample LangChain agent using our gateway (batching + KV cache). We should give Flux a perf target for the listing.
Jin (Runtime): Quick ask: what's the target seq length & concurrency? Typical LangChain demos use short seqs but high concurrent agents. If they want embeddings + chat, we should recommend model variants.
Emily (Partnerships): Flux's initial ask: list has example app with chain-of-thought demo (short seqs), and a connector that streams to a hosted vector DB. They expect ~200rps peak during demo windows.
Marco (Marketplace): For Azure/Google marketplace listings we need a one-pager, logo, 30-day trial plan, and a privacy blurb. Also they require a contact for billing + legal. We should align PR embargo date before we submit.
Grace (Integrations): I'll outline SSO steps: 1) OIDC endpoint exchange 2) redirect URI allowlist 3) token introspection path 4) optional SCIM for provisioning. Add a note about token lifetime.
Samir (Platform Eng): For gateway adapter we need an adapter contract: supported endpoints, auth exchange, and resiliency modes. Suggest we provide two modes: auth-proxy (customer tokens) and delegated-service (service-to-service).
Olivia (Solutions): Can we produce a short perf matrix we can put in the listing: e.g., 2x latency with 4k context vs 1k, throughput at 8 GPUs reserved vs burst? Jin?
Jin (Runtime): I can mock a perf table but will need a sample prompt distribution. Give me a tiny script to reproduce. Example run command we can give partners:
```
# local smoke test
REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted python run_sample_agent.py --model redwood-4b --seq 1024 --concurrency 16 --requests 1000
```
Grace (Integrations): Also include a minimal adapter manifest snippet for LangChain so marketplace validators can auto-detect compatibility:
```
adapter_manifest:
  name: flux-langchain-adapter
  runtime_compat: ["redwood-gateway-v1"]
  auth: oicd
  routes:
    - /invoke
    - /healthz
```
Emily (Partnerships): Timeline proposal: 2 weeks to finish tech checklist + perf artifact, week for marketplace submission, coord PR embargo on week 4. Who owns the adapter README and the announcement draft?
Olivia (Solutions): I'll take README + example prompt set. Grace can own the SSO steps.
Grace (Integrations): I got SSO + manifest.
Samir (Platform Eng): Jin and I will do the adapter integration and perf runs. Expect a short PR with `adapter/flux` and perf CSV.
Marco (Marketplace): I'll queue the marketplace intake once the one-pager + trial plan exist. Need legal contact from Flux; Emily can get that.
Emily (Partnerships): I'll obtain legal contact + confirm embargo window with Flux. Also tagging @partner-bot to create a partner record and reminder for next Thursday. :robot_face:
partner-bot: created partner record FLUX-2026-01 and scheduled a follow-up reminder for 2026-03-05.
Samir (Platform Eng): One more ask — do we need to support connector billing metering hooks for marketplace usage? If so, we need to instrument token/req counters in the adapter.
Olivia (Solutions): Yes, marketplace usually wants usage metering; we can expose `x-redwood-usage` headers in the adapter and a small export script. I'll draft that.
Emily (Partnerships): Great. Action items: Emily = legal contact + embargo; Grace = SSO checklist + manifest; Olivia = README + usage header spec + example prompt set; Samir/Jin = adapter PR + perf CSV; Marco = marketplace intake when ready. We'll reconvene next Thu 10am PT. :calendar: :heavy_check_mark:
Grace (Integrations): Noted. I'll drop the checklist + manifest link in this thread when ready.
Olivia (Solutions): I'll attach example prompts and a short demo script to the PR.
Jin (Runtime): Running an initial smoke later today, will report numbers.
Emily (Partnerships): Thanks team — sounds like a plan. :tada:
